title: Student journey · Léa
goal: From hesitating in everyday conversation to using one useful skill with confidence.
source: Léa persona · patient, personalized human guidance
steps: Attempt a conversation
Research-informed situation
Tries to express one idea in an everyday conversation.

Everyday conversation
Existing language apps
Native videos or audio
Frustrated
I know some words, but I freeze when I need to use them.
Pressure and generic practice make the gap feel bigger.
Explore Mimo
Proposed discovery
Explores Mimo as a possible source of one-to-one support.

Mimo introduction
Welcome screen
Explanation of tutoring
Cautiously hopeful
Maybe a patient teacher could help me say what I mean.
Needs a clear promise, without unrealistic progress claims.
Set a learning goal
Current onboarding
Describes one practical situation she wants to handle.

Account setup
Language, level and goal
Optional resources/preferences
Understood
I can explain what I need and leave some choices for later.
Setup must feel manageable; optional answers stay optional.
Choose a teacher
Proposed experience
Selects a teacher whose approach fits her learning needs.

Teacher profiles
Teaching approach
Lesson format and rate
Uncertain → reassured
Will this teacher understand me and be patient?
A clear teaching approach helps her judge compatibility.
Book a lesson
Proposed experience
Reserves one available session with her chosen teacher.

Teacher availability
Booking details
Booking confirmation
Hesitant but committed
This time works for me. I want to know exactly what I am booking.
Clear timing, price and session details reduce uncertainty.
Practise with a teacher
Proposed experience
Practises one everyday conversation with her teacher.

One-to-one call or meeting
Teacher-led activity
Shared notes and feedback
Supported
I can ask again and make mistakes without feeling judged.
Respectful feedback matters more than finishing an exercise.
Try the skill in real life
Proposed outcome
Uses the practised skill in an everyday interaction.

Everyday interaction
Teacher-approved recap
Optional practice / private feedback
More confident
I managed that conversation. I know what I want to practise next.
Progress should be visible in useful tasks, without daily pressure.

title: Teacher journey · Gilbert
goal: From scattered preparation to a personal lesson he can adapt, teach and follow up.
source: Teacher synthesis · adaptation and creative control
steps: Find suitable materials
Research-informed situation
Searches his existing resources for material suited to the learner.

Personal files and worksheets
Email or messaging
Calendar and learner notes
Stretched
I want more time to teach, but preparation keeps expanding.
Fragmented tools and repeated adaptation create extra work.
Create a teaching profile
Current onboarding
Creates a profile describing his teaching offer.

Teacher account/profile setup
Teaching preferences and rate
Optional identity-check preview
Cautiously optimistic
I want to explain how I teach and keep control of my offer.
The prototype simulates checks; it does not approve a live profile.
Read the learner’s goal
Proposed experience
Reads the learner’s brief to understand the desired outcome.

Learner goal brief
Private conversation
Availability and session details
Focused
What does this learner need to do, and what is difficult now?
A short, specific brief is more useful than extra administration.
Adapt a lesson
Proposed experience
Adapts one reusable lesson to the learner’s level and goal.

Lesson library
Reusable template
Modular lesson editor
In control
I can adapt a useful starting point instead of rebuilding everything.
Reuse must preserve personalization and the teacher's method.
Approve the lesson
Proposed experience
Approves a lesson version that meets his teaching standards.

Lesson preview
Optional AI draft review
Manual editing and share action
Alert → confident
If a suggestion is wrong, I can change it or use my own material.
AI stays optional; unreviewed drafts remain unshared.
Teach the session
Proposed experience
Teaches one personal lesson focused on the learner’s goal.

One-to-one call or meeting
Shared lesson material
Live notes and correction
Engaged
The plan supports the conversation; I can change it as we go.
Tools should support attention and human judgment.
Share a recap
Proposed experience
Shares a teacher-approved recap of the session.

Learner record
Teacher-approved recap
Private feedback / next-session plan
Satisfied, still attentive
I know what to work on next without writing everything again.
Less follow-up work is a hypothesis to test, not a measured result.
